## Design roles

Each part does a job for the person. These are the jobs, as questions the part answers.

<div class="odv-am-rolelist"><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Containment</b> What holds this?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Layering</b> What sits on top?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Hierarchy</b> What do you read first?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Readability</b> Can you read it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Emphasis</b> Where does the eye go?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Meaning</b> What state is it in?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Affordance</b> Can you act on it?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Feedback</b> Did it respond?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Focus</b> Where is the keyboard?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Grouping</b> What belongs together?</span><span class="odv-am-role big"><b>Reach</b> Can you hit it?</span></div>

## How the decisions reach each part

Each part follows a chain: an answer about the product, the rule it set, the token that carries it, and the value you see. The numbers match the drawing.

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-1"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/multi-brand/toggle/card-1.png" alt="Body: 1" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">1</i><b>Body</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="Can you act on it?">Affordance</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="Can you hit it?">Reach</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Shape · What should control corners say? → Rounded</div><div class="odv-am-why">Rounded by default; each brand sets its own corner.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Accessibility · What is the smallest target? → Touch size</div><div class="odv-am-why">Customers sign up on phones.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Spacing · How dense is the layout? → Comfortable</div><div class="odv-am-why">Comfortable spacing in every brand.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For corners of buttons and inputs, use radius.control (set by the brand). Don't use a hard-coded radius.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Each brand sets its own corner through the theme.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For the smallest clickable thing, use size.control.default (touch). Don't use a compact control.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Customers are often on phones.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>radius.control</code><span>→</span><code>radius</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.25rem</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> radius.4: Rounded by default; each brand sets its own corner.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>component-spacing-map.x2</code><span>→</span><code>default.padding-x</code><span class="odv-am-val">0.5rem</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> space.8</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-2"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/multi-brand/toggle/card-2.png" alt="Label: 2" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">2</i><b>Label</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="Can you read it?">Readability</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Typography · Which text roles does it need? → Core: heading, body, label</div><div class="odv-am-why">One set of roles across brands.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.text.primary</code><span>→</span><code>label</code><span class="odv-am-val">#0F172A · dark #F8FAFC</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">Body text and headings.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> neutral.900: the strongest text step, 17.85:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.</div><div><b>Dark</b> neutral.900: the strongest text step, 17.06:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> surface.inverse. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.text.primary.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>type.body.font-size</code><span>→</span><code>font-size</code><span class="odv-am-val">1rem</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> font.weight.600</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-3"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/multi-brand/toggle/card-3.png" alt="On: 3" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">3</i><b>On</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="What state is it in?">Meaning</span><span class="odv-am-role" title="Did it respond?">Feedback</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Accessibility · How many signals carry each meaning? → Two: color and word</div><div class="odv-am-why">Brand colors vary, so meaning needs a word.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Accessibility · Which states get their own visible value? → Those and pressed</div><div class="odv-am-why">Pressed for touch.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For a selected row or item, use color.surface.selected (from the brand). Don't use a fixed blue.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Selection follows the brand color.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.surface.selected</code><span>→</span><code>background.on</code><span class="odv-am-val">#DEF3F0 · dark #012C28</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.surface.selected.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.border.selected</code><span>→</span><code>edge.on</code><span class="odv-am-val">#0F766E · dark #7FCFC6</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">The edge that marks a selected item, beside its fill, so selection is never color alone.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> teal.light.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 5.47:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.</div><div><b>Dark</b> teal.dark.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 9.9:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> border.focus, action.primary, category.1. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.border.selected.</div></div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>border-width.default</code><span>→</span><code>edge-width.on</code><span class="odv-am-val">1px</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> border-width.1</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

<section class="odv-am-card" id="part-4"><div class="odv-am-img wide"><span class="odv-am-assetbox"><img class="odv-am-asset" src="/anatomy/multi-brand/toggle/card-4.png" alt="Hover fill: 4" loading="lazy"/></span></div><div class="odv-am-body"><header><i class="odv-am-n">4</i><b>Hover fill</b><span class="odv-am-role" title="Did it respond?">Feedback</span></header><ul class="odv-am-tree"><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Accessibility · Which states get their own visible value? → Those and pressed</div><div class="odv-am-why">Pressed for touch.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Answer</b><div class="odv-am-main">Motion · How fast does feedback feel? → Moderate</div><div class="odv-am-why">Moderate speed across brands.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Rule</b><div class="odv-am-main">For hover and press feedback, use motion.duration.feedback (moderate). Don't use brand-specific motion.</div><div class="odv-am-why">Motion is shared, so one component library behaves the same in every brand.</div></li><li><b class="odv-am-lbl">Token</b><div class="odv-am-chain"><code>color.surface.highlight</code><span>→</span><code>background.hover</code><span class="odv-am-val">#F1F5F9 · dark #1E293B</span><span class="odv-byscheme" title="Its value changes by scheme. The part is the same in every scheme."><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="11" height="11" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11 10 3 3"/><path d="M6.5 21A3.5 3.5 0 1 0 3 17.5a2.62 2.62 0 0 1-.708 1.792A1 1 0 0 0 3 21z"/><path d="M9.969 17.031 21.378 5.624a1 1 0 0 0-3.002-3.002L6.967 14.031"/></svg>By scheme</span></div><div class="odv-am-why">The fill of the item the pointer or the keyboard is on, or whose submenu is open. A state shows on the item's background, one step from the surface it sits on: darker in light, lighter in dark.</div><div class="odv-am-lines"><div><b>Pick</b> neutral.100, two steps darker than the surfaces it sits on (neutral.0), so the item under the pointer or the keyboard reads as a band without lifting off the page. It skips neutral.50, the page canvas, so a menu item never matches the page behind it.</div><div><b>Dark</b> neutral.100, one step lighter than the surfaces it sits on (neutral.50), so the item under the pointer or the keyboard reads as a band on the menu and on cards.</div><div><b>Shares the step with</b> surface.sunken, action.secondary.hover, disabled.surface. Changing this pick moves only what reads color.surface.highlight.</div></div></li></ul></div></section>

## For agents

Agents get this same anatomy: every part, its roles, whether it is required, the tokens it reads and the decisions behind them.

- **From an AI agent:** call the `get_anatomy` tool on the Open DS MCP server, with this scheme and `toggle`.
- **From a terminal:** `npx open-ds anatomy multi-brand toggle`
